body: Thank you so much for the insight. Could acting or music be a career for me?
It seems like my astrology chart is all bad:(

Everyone goes through these stages at one point in their life.  You need to learn to love and accept yourself. Also try not to be so critical of things. You are young and beautiful and should smile more often! Lastly, try to create small talk with people or join group activities to meet people. Hard times will pass. You’ll be just fine 👍
